_comment: Hard release gates checked by cua.pipeline.corpus_audit.corpus_health_violations. `cua/sft/legacy_train_qwen.py convert` refuses to write the dataset on a violation (--skip-health-gate bypasses for experiments only); `python -m cua.pipeline.corpus_audit` exits 1 on the per-trajectory subset it computes (min_done_evidence_share, min_outcome_relabeled_share; the Modal lane's pre-train check). Each check runs only when its caller computed the stat. Null disables a check.
